goal: Let a probe say which of its exit codes mean 'this run says nothing', so harness-lab's UNJUDGEABLE exit (2) is recorded as INCONCLUSIVE instead of NOT VERIFIED, and a broken setup no longer reads as a broken skill in `ledger receipts` (agent-ledger M3 unit 1).
changed: verify-work's receipt.py takes --inconclusive-exit N, repeatable: a listed exit code gives INCONCLUSIVE, the receipt keeps the exit code, and the entry's why says the code was marked as saying nothing. Exit 0 is refused. No code is inconclusive without the flag.
verify-work's SKILL.md step 9, references/checklist.md and the script's docstring state the new rule; checklist items take the flag too, since they share the verdict rule.

claims.claim: Against agent-ledger main, a probe exiting 2 with --inconclusive-exit 2 is recorded INCONCLUSIVE, the same probe without the flag NOT VERIFIED, and a probe exiting 0 VERIFIED; `ledger receipts` shows all three with exit codes and `ledger verify` passes.
claims.check: receipt.py in a scratch repo with agent-ledger main (6dea4a6) on PATH as ledger, then ledger receipts and ledger verify
claims.remaining: A real harness-lab case was not run as the probe; its exit 2 was stood in for by sh -c 'exit 2'.

claims.claim: check-product.py --receipts still refuses a ticked box whose last receipt is INCONCLUSIVE, and backs one whose receipt is VERIFIED.
claims.check: C1 and C3 ticked in the scratch repo, then check-product.py --receipts 2026-11-27-live --base HEAD~1
claims.remaining: The scratch repo is not a full product scaffold; its other problems are missing scaffold files.

claims.claim: Five new tests fail without the change and pass with it, and the whole suite passes.
claims.check: tests/test_receipt_script.py with AGENT_LEDGER_SRC set to agent-ledger main, before and after; make test and make versions BASE=origin/main
claims.remaining: CI skips the real-ledger tests (no AGENT_LEDGER_SRC), so in CI only the verdict-rule and refusal tests guard this.

next.source: agent-ledger M3 unit 1, feature PR 4 (in a parallel session)
next.why_now: That PR writes receipts for harness-lab cases, and without the flag an UNJUDGEABLE run is recorded as NOT VERIFIED.
next.impact: A run that couldn't judge the skill shows as INCONCLUSIVE in ledger receipts, so a broken setup isn't read as a broken skill.
